name: Maurice Collins
headline: Finance Transformation Project Manager | ERP and Shared Services Specialist | C-SuiteTrusted Advisor
position: Interim / Project Manager | Finance Transformation | ERP Consultant
about:
With extensive experience in merger integration, finance transformation, ERP implementations and project management across diverse sectors, including logistics, real estate, and financial services at the front-line in 14 European and 5 LATAM countries, I offer a practical, results-driven approach to merger integrations and finance transformation, focusing on deployment, project efficiency and stakeholder engagement.

My expertise includes leading complex ERP implementations, specialising in finance and procurement functions (O2C, P2P, and R2R), and aligning projects with business goals to maximise value. 
I am experienced in managing change and advising C-suite executives, by providing insights that enable and support strategic decision-making. 

Recent clients include CEVA Group, CBRE, and Adecco Gruppe, where I have driven project turnarounds and deployed operational efficiencies by delivering merger integrations and transformation projects that meet the unique needs of each organisation.

I am available for consulting engagements and project leadership roles, enabling organisations to implement a platform to achieve seamless merger integrations, finance transformations and ERP optimisations.

Skills:
● Merger & Acquisition (M&A) integration
● ERP Implementation and Strategy
● Finance Transformation and Shared Services Optimisation
● Target Operating Model (TOM) Design and Deployment
● Business Process Reengineering
● Change Management and Stakeholder Engagement
● C-Suite Advisory and Project Leadership
… more
